whenToUse: A month, multi-month or year view with markers per day: holidays, absences, availability.
Inline date selection where the calendar is always visible (booking, leave planning).
avoidWhen: A date field inside a form — use Date Picker.
Timed events with durations — use Agenda / scheduler.
People × days allocation — use Resource calendar.
a11y: Grid navigation with arrow keys, PageUp/PageDown for months; selected days are announced.
Day markers need text equivalents (aria-label: 3 people on leave).
